about.title: About Haonuo Machinery
about.subtitle: Your trusted hydraulic oil press manufacturer since 2010
about.companyDesc: Shandong Haonuo Machinery Equipment Group Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer of hydraulic oil press machines and auxiliary oil processing equipment. Founded in 2010, we have over 15 years of experience in designing and manufacturing high-performance oil pressing equipment.
about.missionDesc: To provide the most reliable and efficient hydraulic oil press machines that help our customers succeed in the oil pressing business.
about.storyP1: Founded in 2010 in Qingzhou, Shandong — a city with a deep tradition in mechanical engineering — Haonuo Machinery began with a simple mission: to build reliable, efficient hydraulic oil press machines that help oil producers maximize their yield and minimize their costs.
about.storyP2: Our founder, with over 20 years of experience in hydraulic systems, recognized that many oil producers were struggling with low-efficiency presses and unreliable suppliers. Starting from a small workshop with just 10 workers, we focused relentlessly on product quality and customer satisfaction.
about.storyP3: Today, that dedication has made us an established hydraulic oil press machine manufacturer in China, trusted by thousands of customers across 50+ countries — from India and Nigeria to the Philippines and the Middle East. Our story is still being written, and we invite you to be part of it.
about.overviewTitle: Professional Hydraulic Oil Press Machine Manufacturer
about.overviewP2: Located in Qingzhou, Weifang, Shandong Province — China's renowned machinery manufacturing hub — our 3,000m² factory is equipped with advanced CNC machining centers, professional assembly lines, and strict quality control systems. With over 200 skilled employees, we deliver reliable oil pressing equipment to customers worldwide.
about.overviewP3: As a direct oil press machine China manufacturer, we provide factory-direct pricing, comprehensive technical support, and lifetime after-sales service to every customer.
about.manufacturingDesc: Our 3,000m² factory in Qingzhou is equipped with state-of-the-art machinery and staffed by 200+ skilled professionals dedicated to producing high-quality hydraulic oil press machines.
about.capCncDesc: Advanced CNC lathes and milling machines ensure precision parts with tolerances within ±0.01mm
about.capAssemblyDesc: Dedicated assembly lines with standardized procedures for consistent product quality
about.capQcDesc: In-house testing lab for material analysis, pressure testing, and performance validation
about.capRdDesc: Experienced engineering team focused on hydraulic system innovation and product improvement
about.capPaintDesc: Professional sandblasting and anti-corrosion coating for long-lasting machine durability
about.capWarehouseDesc: Sufficient raw material and spare parts stock for production within 20-30 working days (shipping time additional)
about.qualityDesc: Every hydraulic oil press machine undergoes rigorous quality checks before leaving our factory, ensuring reliable performance and long service life.
about.qualityIsoDesc: Comprehensive quality management system covering design, procurement, production, inspection, and delivery — every machine is rigorously tested before shipment.
about.qualityMaterialDesc: All raw materials (steel, hydraulic components, seals) are inspected and tested upon arrival. Only certified materials enter production.
about.qualityInspectionDesc: Every machine undergoes 48-hour continuous running test, pressure test, and performance validation before packaging. Video proof provided to customers.
about.globalDesc: Our hydraulic oil press machines are trusted by customers in 50+ countries. Key markets include India, Nigeria, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Philippines, Kenya, and the Middle East.
about.globalMore: ...and many more countries across Central Asia, South America, and Europe.
about.whyChooseDesc: As a direct hydraulic oil press machine manufacturer, we offer unique advantages that trading companies simply cannot match.
about.why1Desc: As a manufacturer, we eliminate middlemen and offer competitive factory-direct prices — typically saving compared to trading company prices (actual savings vary by product and market).
about.why2Desc: Since 2010, we have specialized exclusively in hydraulic oil press machines, accumulating deep technical knowledge and proven solutions.
about.why3Desc: Every machine undergoes 48-hour continuous testing, material inspection, and pre-shipment trial run before delivery.
about.why4Desc: Successfully exported to 50+ countries with full documentation support including CO, Form A/E, and embassy legalization.
about.why5Desc: 20-30 working days production time; inquiries answered within 24 hours with professional technical consultation.
about.why6Desc: Free installation guidance, operation training, and lifetime technical support via video call, WhatsApp, or on-site service.
about.factoryDesc: Take a virtual tour of our manufacturing facility. Factory visits are also welcome — contact us to schedule a tour.
about.ctaDesc: Contact us today for a free quotation on hydraulic oil press machines. As a direct manufacturer, we offer competitive pricing and full technical support.
